_meta.notes: Aligned with actual text_loader sentence-splitting output (8 sentences → 8 fragments). DECLARE constraints verified against all 5 execution traces — all 10 constraints are satisfied by the original model. Removed two problematic constraints from earlier draft: Precedence(make_booking→close_case) which is violated on T1 (recourse not possible), and Response(check_case→send_request) which is violated on T1 as well. This process has a single lane (Recourse Clerk), so M5 lane-change mutation is N/A.

fragments.text: If an insurant could be possibly subrogated against, I get information about that.
I check that case and if the possibility is really there, I send a request for payment to the insurant and make me a reminder.
fragments.role: multi-action sentence: check case + send request + send reminder

fragments.text: If recourse is not possible, I close the case.
When we receive the money, I make a booking and close the case.
If the insurant disagrees with the recourse, I will have to check the reasoning of that.
If he is right, I simply close the case.
If he is wrong, I forward the case to a collection agency.
It the deadline for disagreement is reached and we have not received any money, I forward the case to the collection agency as well.

mappings.fragment_text: If an insurant could be possibly subrogated against, I get information about that.
mappings.reasoning: 'insurant could be possibly subrogated' = 'probable recourse detected' — this fragment describes the start trigger. Note: the text says 'I get information about that' which implies an active step, but the BPMN model has no explicit 'get information' task — this is a genuine structural inconsistency between text and model. The closest element is the message start event.

mappings.fragment_text: I check that case and if the possibility is really there, I send a request for payment to the insurant and make me a reminder.
mappings.reasoning: This sentence describes THREE actions: 'check that case' (= check case, Task_0iirfhd), 'send a request for payment' (= send request for payment, Task_02fdytg), and 'make me a reminder' (= send reminder, Task_12lthpj). The primary mapping is to 'check case' as the first dominant action. The system will likely return only one node for this fragment, so both Task_0iirfhd and Task_02fdytg are acceptable correct answers.

mappings.fragment_text: If recourse is not possible, I close the case.
mappings.reasoning: 'I close the case' = 'close case'. Contextually this is Task_04aofbe reached via the 'no' branch of 'recourse possible?' gateway. Note: there are 3 tasks named 'close case' in the BPMN — the mapper should distinguish by context ('if recourse is not possible' → 'no' branch). Any close case task ID is acceptable in evaluation since all share the same name.

mappings.fragment_text: When we receive the money, I make a booking and close the case.
mappings.reasoning: This fragment maps to TWO tasks in sequence: 'make a booking' = Task_1bwmf45 ('make booking') and 'close the case' = Task_0yan60f ('close case'). Primary mapping is 'make booking' as the distinctive action. The trigger 'when we receive the money' maps to IntermediateCatchEvent_0d430z1 ('Money received').

mappings.fragment_text: If the insurant disagrees with the recourse, I will have to check the reasoning of that.
mappings.reasoning: 'check the reasoning' = 'check reasoning'. Exact semantic match. The trigger 'if the insurant disagrees' maps to IntermediateCatchEvent_1ias0p2 ('disagreement letter received').

mappings.fragment_text: If he is right, I simply close the case.
mappings.reasoning: 'close the case' reached via the 'yes' branch of 'OK?' gateway — Task_1qlbv5i. Since all three close case tasks share the same BPMN name, evaluate.py also accepts Task_04aofbe as correct (same name, reasonable alternative). Task_0yan60f (money path) is contextually less likely for this fragment.

mappings.fragment_text: If he is wrong, I forward the case to a collection agency.
mappings.reasoning: 'forward the case to a collection agency' = 'hand over to collection agency'. Slight wording difference but clearly the same action. Reached via the 'no' branch of 'OK?' gateway.

mappings.fragment_text: It the deadline for disagreement is reached and we have not received any money, I forward the case to the collection agency as well.
mappings.reasoning: Same task as frag_07 but via a different path: the timer event branch. 'deadline for disagreement is reached' maps to IntermediateCatchEvent_037r6f2 ('Reminder is due'). Both frag_07 and frag_08 correctly point to the same 'hand over to collection agency' task, which is reachable via two different paths in the model.

constraints.reasoning: First action after start event — always occurs in every execution path. Violated by mutation M1 that deletes 'check case'.

constraints.source_text: I send a request for payment to the insurant and make me a reminder
constraints.reasoning: The text says 'send a request AND make me a reminder' — whenever the payment request is sent, a reminder must follow. Verified: satisfied in all 5 execution traces. Violated by M1 that deletes 'send reminder'.

constraints.source_text: I send a request for payment to the insurant and make me a reminder
constraints.reasoning: Ordering implied: send request first, then send reminder. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces. Violated by M3 that swaps their order.

constraints.source_text: I check that case... If recourse is not possible, I close the case
constraints.reasoning: Any 'close case' occurrence requires 'check case' to have happened first. This applies to all three 'close case' tasks in the model. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces (T1: check case → close case; T2-T3: check case → ... → close case; T4-T5: close case never occurs).

constraints.source_text: I check that case and if the possibility is really there, I send a request for payment
constraints.reasoning: Payment request can only happen after the case was checked. Structural ordering. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces.

constraints.source_text: I make a booking and close the case
constraints.reasoning: The text explicitly sequences these: 'make a booking AND close the case'. If make booking occurs, close case must follow. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces (make booking only occurs in T2, where close case follows).

constraints.source_text: When we receive the money, I make a booking... If he is wrong, I forward the case to a collection agency
constraints.reasoning: These activities belong to mutually exclusive paths via the event-based gateway. 'make booking' is only on the 'money received' path; 'hand over' is on the 'disagreement' or 'timeout' paths. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces.

constraints.source_text: make me a reminder... When we receive the money, I make a booking
constraints.reasoning: Structural: the event-based gateway (which leads to the make booking path) follows 'send reminder'. Make booking can only occur after a reminder was sent. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces (T1-T3,T4-T5: make booking doesn't occur → vacuously true; T2: send reminder precedes make booking).

constraints.source_text: make me a reminder... I forward the case to the collection agency
constraints.reasoning: Both paths that lead to 'hand over to collection agency' (disagreement and timeout) go through the event-based gateway, which follows 'send reminder'. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces.

constraints.source_text: make me a reminder... I will have to check the reasoning
constraints.reasoning: The 'check reasoning' step follows the 'disagreement letter received' branch of the event-based gateway, which itself follows 'send reminder'. Verified: satisfied in all 5 traces.

_evaluation_notes.m5_reason: Recourse is a single-lane process (one participant 'Recourse Clerk') — lane-change mutation has no meaningful targets. mutate.py will auto-skip M5.
_evaluation_notes.multi_name_warning: Three BPMN tasks share the name 'close case' (Task_04aofbe, Task_1qlbv5i, Task_0yan60f). The Mapper agent must disambiguate by context. evaluate.py accepts any 'close case' task ID as correct for frag_06 due to node_id_secondary and node_id_tertiary fields. Constraint evaluation uses activity names, so all three tasks match 'close case' constraints — this is correct DECLARE semantics.
_evaluation_notes.genuine_inconsistency: frag_01 describes 'I get information about that' as an active step, but the BPMN model has no corresponding task — only a message start event 'probable recourse detected'. This is a real text-model inconsistency that a working pipeline should flag.
